messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty — SEV2: API-GW (edge) 502/504 spike detected. Error rate jumped from ~0.6% -> ~9% in the last 5m. Top affected regions: eu-west-1, us-east-1. Paging @alice.h (oncall), @ben_s (sre). Please ack.

alice.h: Acked. I'm taking lead. Any recent deploys or routing changes?

ben_s: I see an automated mux rollout started ~06:12 UTC (rollout id 2026-03-mux-42). 95% of 5xx are from mux hostpool-b.*. Traces show 502s originate at edge -> api-gw when trying to connect to upstream origin pools (timeouts / connection resets).

carter: Confirmed. The rollout toggled sticky-session affinity for a subset of routes. Rolling back the rollout now.

alice.h: Rollback please post commands and ETA.

carter: Running:
```bash
kubectl -n edge-rollouts patch rollout/mux-release-42 -p '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'
# then rollback to mux-release-41
kubectl -n edge-rollouts rollout undo deployment/mux -to-revision=41
```
ETA ~4m

lisa_p: Support tracker: ~18 customers logged failed requests in last 15m. Most noisy: Search API and Autocomplete endpoints.

sre_lead: While rollback proceeds, enable short-circuit fallback in front of mux to reduce fanout and protect upstreams. Set circuit threshold to ~5% 5xx over 1m.

alice.h: Enabling edge-circuit policy now. Pushing policy change.

ben_s: Enforced policy. Metrics update: failed rate down to 4.2% after circuit enable. p50 latency still +120ms. Traces show backend pool api-backend-c under connection pressure.

carter: Opening quick mitigation: increase backend connection pool and reduce new connection churn at the gateway. Applying gateway config patch.

alice.h: Applying patch to gateway in eu-west and us-east: 
```yaml
gateway:
  upstream:
    maxConnections: 600
    connIdleTimeout: 60s
```

support_bot: Posting customer-facing banner: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/172555 (partial outage: Search API degraded). Notifying on-call support.

ben_s: After gateway patch + circuit, eu-west 5xx down to ~1.1%. us-east trending down as well.

product_ops: Any VIPs impacted? We should escalate messaging if so.

lisa_p: VIP list: Acme Inc, Nova Apps — Acme reported timeouts; support assigned P1.

sre_lead: Still seeing occasional 504s traced to a rate-limiter config that was lowered during the rollout. Carter, can you inspect limiter rules pushed with rollout 42?

carter: Found it — limiter per-route burst was set to 10 instead of the intended 100 for several Search routes. Fixing now, patching to 100.

alice.h: Re-deploying limiter fix. Monitoring.

ben_s: Final metrics: global 5xx at ~0.4%, Search API errors back to baseline. p95 latency normalized. No new spikes for 12m.

alice.h: Thanks all. I'll collect timeline/traces for the postmortem. Support to send customer follow-ups. Leaving channel open for 30m for any regressions.

oncall-bot: Incident resolved by oncall (alice.h). Duration 22m. Suspected root causes: automated mux rollout + limiter misconfiguration + backend connection pressure. Create postmortem and tag #postmortems.

product_ops: Thx — will file customer follow-ups and updated status page message.

alice.h: Closing channel in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:
